generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A structural/data-flow detector can appear comprehensive while omitting semantically equivalent execution containers, lexical scope transitions, aggregate aliases, or documentation claims that exceed the exercised surface set.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Patch only the literal escaped syntax instead of proving operation x execution-container x lexical-scope x aggregate-reference coverage and claim parity.

reusable_control.procedure: Vary a forbidden value-flow operation across execution container, lexical capture/shadowing and aggregate/reference shape, while retaining a canonical allowed control and matching documentation claim.
reusable_control.expected: All prohibited semantic siblings are rejected, intentional shadowing/canonical flow stay accepted, and documentation states only exercised coverage.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Structural-flow implementations must enumerate semantic propagation surfaces (execution containers, lexical scope and aggregate/reference shapes) before implementation and include negative controls for each material surface.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Adversarial review must move the same forbidden flow across function kind, closure capture/shadowing and object/array alias forms, then compare broad documentation claims against the exercised surface matrix.

transfer_cases.case: Move the same forbidden flow from a declaration into an arrow or class method without changing semantics.
Route the same forbidden value through object spread, array position or destructuring before consumption.
Capture the value in a closure and contrast with an intentionally shadowed safe binding.

skill_changes.validation: Focused contract test passed and genericity validator is READY.
